fields.label: All Ports
fields.help: The 'ports', 'portRange', and 'allPorts' fields are mutually exclusive.

fields.label: Allow Global Access
fields.help: This field is used along with the 'backend_service' field for internal load balancing or with the 'target' field for internal TargetInstance.

fields.label: Allow Psc Global Access
fields.help: This is used in PSC consumer ForwardingRule to control whether the PSC endpoint can be accessed from another region.

fields.label: Backend Service
fields.help: Identifies the backend service to which the forwarding rule sends traffic.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: IP Address
fields.help: IP address for which this forwarding rule accepts traffic.

fields.label: IP Collection
fields.help: Resource reference of a PublicDelegatedPrefix.

fields.label: IP Protocol
fields.help: The IP protocol to which this rule applies.

fields.label: IP Version
fields.help: The IP address version that will be used by this forwarding rule.

fields.label: Is Mirroring Collector
fields.help: Indicates whether or not this load balancer can be used as a collector for packet mirroring.

fields.label: Load Balancing Scheme
fields.help: Specifies the forwarding rule type.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource; provided by the client when the resource is created.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: This field is not used for external load balancing.

fields.label: Network Tier
fields.help: This signifies the networking tier used for configuring this load balancer and can only take the following values: 'PREMIUM', 'STANDARD'.

fields.label: No Automate DNS Zone
fields.help: This is used in PSC consumer ForwardingRule to control whether it should try to auto-generate a DNS zone or not.

fields.label: Port Range
fields.help: The 'ports', 'portRange', and 'allPorts' fields are mutually exclusive.

fields.label: Ports
fields.help: The 'ports', 'portRange', and 'allPorts' fields are mutually exclusive.

fields.label: Recreate Closed Psc
fields.help: This is used in PSC consumer ForwardingRule to make terraform recreate the ForwardingRule when the status is closed

fields.label: Region
fields.help: A reference to the region where the regional forwarding rule resides.

fields.label: Service Label
fields.help: An optional prefix to the service name for this Forwarding Rule.

fields.label: Source IP Ranges
fields.help: If not empty, this Forwarding Rule will only forward the traffic when the source IP address matches one of the IP addresses or CIDR ranges set here.

fields.label: Subnetwork
fields.help: This field identifies the subnetwork that the load balanced IP should belong to for this Forwarding Rule, used in internal load balancing and network load balancing with IPv6.

fields.label: Target
fields.help: The URL of the target resource to receive the matched traffic.

fields.label: Service Directory Registrations
Namespace
fields.help: Service Directory namespace to register the forwarding rule under.

fields.label: Service
fields.help: Service Directory service to register the forwarding rule under.
Service Directory resources to register this forwarding rule with.
